picture: A blank warm page. A pencil strip of film draws itself left to right, sprocket holes and empty frames; the card writes on.
camera: wide, locked, strip in the lower third
sound: pencil scratch along the strip, two soft piano notes

picture: AF is sketched in over construction lines, blinks awake with its aperture, looks at us, then glances back left.
camera: wide, locked

lines.English: Hi, I'm AF. / I'm a roll of film: one frame per commit.
lines.中文: 你好，我是 AF。/ 我是一卷胶片：每次提交，曝光一格。

sound: shutter-blade blink tick, a rising two-note hello

picture: The film canister from the logo rolls in from the left; AF crouches, and the canister hops onto its back. The keepsake is set.
camera: wide, locked
sound: rolling tin, a bonk, a happy chirp
note: keepsake: the canister, paid off at 1:54

card: A gallery for photographers · your photos, the way you shot them · Jun 5, 2025 · 14 commits
picture: Day one: AF sprints along the strip firing the flash; 14 frames expose one by one, each a tiny sketched photo. Margin note under the first frame.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: Day one: fourteen frames. / The first one just says init.
lines.中文: 第一天，十四格。/ 第一格只写着 init。

note: f841d2ad feat: init, 2025-06-05, 14 commits that day

picture: AF walks on into Jun 6; the day mark and edge numbering (25-06-06 ▸ 11) write on.
camera: follows right, slowing

card: WebGL viewer · zoom into huge photos, tile by tile
picture: AF points; focus brackets lock green; one frame lifts off the strip into a big print. Tile lines flash as it zooms 6x onto a tiny climber on the peak, still sharp.
camera: holds; AF left, print right

lines.English: First I learned to look closely. / Really closely.
lines.中文: 我先学会了看清楚。/ 非常、非常清楚。

sound: focus-lock beep, a rising glissando with the zoom
note: 25521e2a tiled rendering, 8f2abb33 LOD, Jun 6. The 6x zoom is illustrative.

card: EXIF & Live Photos · every setting, and the moment around it
picture: AF carries the print overhead through Jun 7 and Jun 8. It flips to its EXIF back, flips again, then wiggles with a LIVE badge.
camera: follows right

lines.English: Every setting you shot with, / and the moment around it.
lines.中文: 你用过的每个参数，/ 还有快门前后的那一瞬。

sound: paper flip, a short shimmer for LIVE
note: ExifPanel.tsx + LivePhoto.tsx are in f841d2ad. EXIF values shown are illustrative.

picture: A darkroom fixer tray sits in the strip at the seam. AF tosses the print in and hops in after it: splash, squeeze, dunk.
camera: follows right; the ink seam enters from the right
sound: splash, bubbles, a low piano note

picture: AF hops out right of the seam in black & white ink, shakes off like a dog, beams. The strip is solid black film from here on.
camera: follows right

lines.English: Four days in, I went public. / Fixer makes a print permanent.
lines.中文: 第四天，我开源了。/ 定影之后，照片就不会褪了。

sound: string pad arrives with the ink; shake rattle

card: Bring your own storage · S3 · GitHub · Eagle · local
picture: An S3 bucket swings down and tips photos onto the strip; a GitHub repo folder follows. Local (#40) and Eagle (#122) folders wait further on.
camera: follows right

lines.English: Keep your photos where they are. / I'll come to them.
lines.中文: 照片放在哪都行，/ 我自己去取。

note: S3 + GitHub storage in init; local #40; Eagle #122

card: Explore map · see where every photo was taken
picture: A hand-drawn map unfolds beside the strip; pins fly out of passing frames onto it.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: If a photo knows where it was taken, / it gets a pin.
lines.中文: 照片记得在哪拍的，/ 我就在地图上插一根针。

picture: AF stops and points; one frame lifts off and glows brighter than the paper; an HDR stamp lands.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: Brighter than white? / On an HDR screen, yes.
lines.中文: 比白还亮？/ 在 HDR 屏幕上，可以。

picture: Frames sorted into piles by camera; the piles topple and AF trips over them, face-plants, sees stars, gets up. A second jam puff further on.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: Not every idea makes it. / I trip, get up, and keep going.
lines.中文: 不是每个点子都能留下。/ 摔一跤，爬起来，接着走。

note: 21a6743c #72 → 001506ee Revert (Aug 4); 444468b8 → d98049de Revert (Sep 21). Camera names on the piles are illustrative.

card: Search · find any photo by place, camera or tag
picture: A search box types 'tokyo'; matching frames light up blue.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: Then search, / so you can find the one you mean.
lines.中文: 然后是搜索，/ 一下找到你要的那张。

picture: AF shoots one frame; a press stamped build:manifest rolls back over the whole strip, then a red 'deploy' stamp lands. AF sighs.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: Back then I was a static site. / One new photo, and everything got rebuilt.
lines.中文: 那时我还是个静态站点。/ 加一张照片，就要整站重建、重新部署。

card: Server + dashboard · upload, sync and edit live, no rebuild
picture: Blueprint paper takes over. AF draws a darkroom (server, red safelight) and a desk (dashboard); a title changes Untitled → Kyoto dawn and the strip updates at once.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: So I built myself a darkroom. / Edit a photo, and it's live.
lines.中文: 于是我给自己盖了间暗房。/ 改一张照片，马上生效。

sound: marimba arpeggios, a chord on the seam
note: bb308820, 223e90d4, #135, #136 (Oct 26–31, 2025). The photo title is illustrative.

card: afilmory.art · sign up, and your gallery is live
picture: A row of doors grows beside the darkroom, each with a nameplate; canisters walk in; AF waves.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: Then I opened the doors. / Anyone can start a gallery here.
lines.中文: 然后我把门打开了。/ 现在谁都能在这开一个相册。

note: bc4cd362 tenants (Nov 6), 26657788 landing (Nov 11). Names on doors are illustrative.

card: Or self-host · the same code, in Docker
picture: A box labelled Docker with a tiny darkroom inside; AF pats it.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: Rather run it yourself? / Same code, one Docker image.
lines.中文: 想自己部署？/ 同一套代码，一个 Docker 镜像。

picture: The strip packs with slivers of frames: November's run. A green street sign 'photos.lea.me' passes.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: November alone: / two hundred and one frames.
lines.中文: 光是十一月，/ 就有两百零一格。

note: 201 commits in Nov 2025; a1710924 custom domains (Nov 20). Domain is illustrative.

picture: Winter: snow of grain, mostly blank leader, a few lonely frames; AF walks slowly, half asleep.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: Then a quiet winter. / Forty-five frames in five months. / I kept walking.
lines.中文: 然后是安静的冬天。/ 五个月，四十五格。/ 我没有停下。

card: iOS app · your gallery, on your iPhone
picture: The page turns to Liquid Glass over colour blur; a cardboard phone costume (RN) drops onto AF.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: Summer. I wanted to fit in your pocket.
lines.中文: 夏天，我想住进你的口袋。

note: e6302a45 first iPhone app, React Native (Jul 29, 2026)

picture: AF sprints in the costume, flash firing on every frame: 34 in a row.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: Thirty-four frames in one day. / My busiest ever.
lines.中文: 一天三十四格，/ 最忙的一天。

sound: shutter rattle over a kick pulse

card: Native Swift · rebuilt from scratch for iPhone
picture: AF squirms in the costume, grabs it and tears it in two; the halves fly off and a native glass AF shines.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: Twelve days in, I tore it down / and rebuilt it natively in Swift.
lines.中文: 十二天后，我把它拆了，/ 用 Swift 原生重写。

note: 8f6468c7 #258 (Aug 10, 2026). The costume is a metaphor for the React Native app.

card: Upload, widgets, notifications · public beta on TestFlight
picture: Glass cards pop up beside the strip: an upload progress pill, a Photo of the day widget, a comment notification.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: Upload from your phone. / A photo of the day on your home screen.
lines.中文: 在手机上传照片，/ 桌面上每天一张。

note: 7cc409e4 upload, #275 widget, cd984710 TestFlight. Names and counts in the cards are illustrative.

card: HDR, in colour · WebGPU + JPEG gain maps
picture: A rainbow seam; the strip turns to real film with glowing colour frames; AF turns Afilmory blue and throws its arms up.
camera: follows right, moving average, no cuts

lines.English: And now colour, / as bright as you shot it.
lines.中文: 现在是彩色的，/ 和你拍下时一样亮。

sound: key lifts to E, bright arpeggio

picture: Pull back until the roll is a line; it is cut into month strips and laid out as a contact sheet, one cell per commit. Jun 2025, Nov 2025 and Aug 2026 are circled. AF walks on and the canister pops: the roll is developed.
camera: pull back, then locked

lines.English: Eight hundred thirty-seven frames. / One roll. Developed.
lines.中文: 八百三十七格，/ 一卷，冲洗好了。

sound: AF's motif returns in E; sparkle on the pop

picture: AF signs under the sheet.
camera: pull back, then locked

lines.English: Shot by AF, for your photos.
lines.中文: 由 AF 拍摄，为你的照片。
